description: As a forestry scientist conducting a timber harvest suitability assessment, integrate the SRTM digital elevation model at /home/ga/snap_data/srtm_dem.tif with the Landsat multispectral imagery at /home/ga/snap_data/landsat_multispectral.tif (band_1=SWIR1, band_2=NIR, band_3=Red, band_4=Green) in SNAP Desktop. Both files must be opened and combined into a single co-registered product so that elevation and spectral data are analyzed together. From the optical bands, derive a vegetation vigor index. From the elevation data, derive a terrain steepness metric. Then create a forest harvest suitability composite that combines the vegetation and terrain information, and produce a classified suitability map with at least three categories (e.g., suitable, marginal, unsuitable) based on conditional thresholds on both the vegetation index and terrain steepness. Save the integrated analysis product in BEAM-DIMAP format and export as GeoTIFF to /home/ga/snap_exports/.

metadata.data_source: SRTM DEM + Landsat satellite imagery from github.com/opengeos/data
